title: ML↔PO-001: Market-Driven ML Features + Model Performance Feedback
description: Product Owner/TPM provides field use-case context and target performance/accuracy requirements expressed as acceptance criteria (not technical specs); Edge AI/ML returns model-readiness status against defined gates and the edge deployment constraints (latency, memory, power) that affect feature scope. Grounded in PRODUCT_OWNER_TECHNICAL_PROJECT_MANAGER_SKILL §6.4.

ml_feature_request.description: PO→ML: market-driven ML features as acceptance criteria.

performance_acceptance_criteria.description: Performance requirement framed as acceptance criteria, not a technical spec.

model_feedback.description: ML→PO: readiness gate + deployment constraints affecting feature scope.

deployment_constraints.description: Edge deployment constraints affecting feature scope.

feature_scope_impact.description: How the constraints reshape achievable feature scope.

x-macp.tier_rationale: The model-readiness gate gates integration scheduling and feeds the QA go/no-go; a dedicated checkpoint precedes each integration. Routine field-context intake is Tier-3.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (sprint-level sync; dedicated checkpoint at each model-readiness gate before integration is scheduled)
confirm_conditions: each ml_feature_request carries use_case_context and a target framed as acceptance criteria
MEETS_GATE carries measured_accuracy_pct against the target
deployment_constraints (latency_ms, memory_kb, power_mw) reported with units when scope is affected
reject_conditions: PO request expressed as a technical model spec rather than acceptance criteria (§6.4 governance note)
measured accuracy below target presented as gate-passing (Honesty Over Polish, §10.3)
counter_conditions: target accuracy infeasible within the edge deployment constraints — request scope/timeline re-negotiation
acceptance criteria not measurable on-device — request an evaluable metric before the gate
